reason: The hypothesis combines the separate findings that Ti additions cause lattice distortion and TiC formation (P2) and that SRO enhances dislocation pinning and strength (P10, P13, P14) into a new, unified mechanistic explanation for the low strength of equimolar CoCrFeNiTi. It proposes a controlled comparison between a fully disordered state and an SRO-induced state in the same alloy, which no passage has done, and designs a falsification test using in-situ TEM to resolve whether the absence of obstacles governs the low hardness.
